item.text:
Yes. Configure separate clients/endpoints:

- Query through the Query API endpoint, typically `https://<host>/search/`.  
  [Vespa querying documentation](https://docs.vespa.ai/en/basics/querying.html)

- Feed through the Document API/feed endpoint, such as `https://<host>/document/v1/`. The feed client accepts its own `--endpoint` value (or endpoint passed to `FeedClientBuilder`).  
  [Vespa feed client documentation](https://docs.vespa.ai/en/clients/vespa-feed-client.html)

For Vespa Cloud specifically, global endpoints support querying but not feeding; feeding must use a zone endpoint.  
[Routing and endpoints](https://docs.vespa.ai/en/operations/endpoint-routing.html)
